description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
課堂規定：
Class Rules:
 
  1. 繳交、上傳作業請務必準時， 一律不接受遲交或補交作業 (請假者請自行注意作業繳交日期)。
    Please ensure to submit or upload your assignments on time. The instructor will not accept any late or makeup assignments, even in cases of absence. If you miss a class, please check and keep track of the assignment deadlines.
     
  2. 點名時一次點兩節課，點名後才進教室者，該節將以曠課論，並請同學於課間自行找教師補點名，以銷掉第二節課之曠課記錄。
    During roll call, attendance is marked for two class periods at once. If you arrive late and miss roll call, you will be marked as absent for both class periods. However, if you arrive during the first class period but after the roll call, please see the instructor during the break to correct your attendance status for the second class period. Otherwise, you will be marked absent for both.
     
  3. 關於請假與曠課：
    • 請假每節扣「課堂表現」總成績0.5分，曠課每節扣「課堂表現」總成績1分。
    • 缺課(包含請假和曠課)次數達12節或以上將無法通過此課程，課程成績以0分計。
    Regarding Excused Absences and Unexcused Absences:
    • Each excused absence will result in a 0.5-point deduction from the overall "Class Performance" grade, while each unexcused absence will result in a 1-point deduction from the same.
    • Missing 12 classes or more (including excused and unexcused absences) will automatically fail the course with a grade of zero.
     
  4. 補考/補做練習一律從80分起扣。
    All scores for makeup quizzes or exercises start from a maximum of 80 points. In other words, the highest score you can achieve for a makeup quiz or exercise is 80, regardless of your performance.
     
  5. 申請課堂小考或練習補考/補做之規定：一學期最多可申請2次，有於系統請假者才可申請，遲到、曠課一律不接受補考或補做。
    Regarding makeup quizzes and exercises: You can take makeup quizzes or exercises up to two times per semester. However, this is conditional upon having an officially recorded leave of absence in the school system. In other words, if you miss a quiz or exercise due to tardiness or unexcused absence from class, you will not be eligible to take the makeup quiz or exercise.
     
  6. 申請補考/補做請於原時間之一個禮拜內申請，逾時不接受補考/補做申請。
    If you wish to take a makeup quiz or exercise, please submit a request to the instructor within one week of the original quiz/exercise date. Any requests made after this period will not be accepted.
     
  7. 期中考和期末考/報告一率不接受補考，除非為特殊原因並符合以下三項：
    • 於考試日期前至少2個禮拜事先告知授課教師
    • 需提供相關正式證明文件 (住院證明、手術證明、參賽證明等)
    • 經授課教師事先同意
    No makeup exams or presentations are allowed for the midterm or final unless there are special circumstances that meet the following three conditions:
    • The instructor has been informed at least two weeks prior to the exam or presentation date;
    • Relevant official documentation can be provided (such as proof of hospitalization, surgery, competition participation, etc.);
    • The instructor has approved the makeup exam or presentation in advance.
     
  8. 期中考/期末考沒有出現或是沒有依規定申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
    If a student does not show up on the day of the midterm exam or final exam, or fails to apply for a makeup exam/presentation according to the rules, the student will automatically receive a score of zero for the exam/presentation.
     
  9. 考試請遵照學校之考場規定，若作弊者一律以0分計算並呈報學生獎懲委員會。
    Please follow the university's exam regulations. Any cheating will result in a score of zero for the exam, and such cases will be referred to the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
期中/期末考學生請假補考說明

逢甲大學學則
第二十六條 學生考核請假獲准之補考規定如下：

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。

Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1. Honesty and Ethical Behavior: Students are expected to exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in all their academic activities. This includes the avoidance of plagiarism and falsification of data. Students are also expected to treat all members of the class with respect. 
    誠實和道德行為：學生在所有學術活動中都應該展現誠實和道德行為，這包括避免抄襲，篡改資料，並尊重所有課堂中的成員。
     
  2. Understanding Plagiarism and Respect for Intellectual Property: Proper citation of sources is mandatory in all academic work. Using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism. Students must respect and recognize the intellectual work of others; this includes understanding and avoiding plagiarism, as well as practicing proper citation and referencing.
    理解抄襲並尊重智慧財產：所有學術工作中都必須適當引用來源。未經適當註明而使用他人的作品將被視為抄襲。學生必須尊重並認識到他人的智慧創作，這包括理解並避免抄襲，並實踐正確適當的引用和註明參考資料。
     
  3. Adherence to Exam Rules and Personal Accountability: All students must follow exam rules. Using unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating. Moreover, all assignments, tests, and projects should be completed independently unless specified as group work. Sharing answers, copying work, or using unauthorized resources is seen as academic dishonesty.
    遵守考試規則與對個人學習負責：所有學生都必須遵守考試規則。在考試中使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊將被視為作弊。此外，除非明確規定為團隊作業，否則所有的作業、考試和專案都應獨立完成。分享答案、抄襲作業或使用未經授權的資源將被視為學術不誠實。
     
  4. Consequences of Violating Academic Integrity: Any violations of academic integrity, including plagiarism and cheating, will be subject to disciplinary action. Consequences may range from grade reduction to failing the course, depending on the severity of the violation. Other disciplinary actions, as per the instructor's discretion, may also be considered.
    違反學術誠信的後果：任何違反學術誠信的行為，包括抄襲和作弊，將受到紀律處分。根據違規的嚴重程度，懲罰可能從降低成績到不通過課程不等。另外，根據教師的判斷，也可能考慮其他的紀律行動。

逢甲大學學則
第二十六條 學生考核請假獲准之補考規定如下：

一、學生因故不能參加各項考核者，須依逢甲大學學生請假辦法完成請假程序，經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。相關規定如下；
(一) 若補考未到者，不得再行補考；但因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病或其他重大事故，持有證明經任課教師核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜。
(二) 學生須在該科考核結束後三日內完成請假程序。

二、學生因懷孕、分娩、育嬰、親喪、重病 (COVID-19不算重大疾病)、依法得申請之公假或公務不能參加各項考核者，需檢具區域級以上醫院或分設診所之診斷證明書、喪假證明文件、依法得申請公假之證明文件，或有關單位主管簽證，並依逢甲大學學生請假辦法之規定，完成請假程序，經核准後由任課教師辦理補考事宜，其補考成績以實得分數計。

註：若學生請假原因非本校學則第二十六條所列，外語教學中心決議其補考成績為實得分數打八折計。

Make-up Exam Policy for Students with Approved Leave (Midterm/Final Exam)
Article 26 The rules for students obtaining leave and permission to take make-up examinations are as follows:

1. Students who cannot participate in assessments for any reason must complete the procedures for leave per the University's regulations on leaves of absence for students, and have their make-up examinations handled by the instructor once the instructor approves. The regulations are as follows:
(1) If a student fails to take a make-up examination, he/she will not be allowed to retake a make-up examination; however, for students who cannot take a make-up examination due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or other major accidents, they are to provide certification. The instructor will handle their second make-up examination once the instructor approves.
(2) Leave procedures must be completed within three days after the end of the course assessment.

2. If a student is unable to participate in any assessment due to pregnancy, childbirth, child-rearing, bereavement, serious illness, or official leave that can be applied for by law or official duties, he/she must present a certificate of diagnosis from a hospital at or above the regional level or an associated clinic, a certificate of bereavement, a certificate of application for official leave that can be applied for by law, or a visa issued by the supervisor of the unit in charge, and then complete leave procedures in accordance with the University's regulations on students' obtaining leaves. Once their leave is approved, the instructor will conduct a make-up examination. The grade of the make-up examination is to be based on the actual score.

Note: If a student's reason for taking leave is not included under Article 26 of the University Regulations, the Foreign Language Center has decided that the student's make-up exam score will be calculated at 80% of the actual score obtained.

integrity.ais_meno:
1. Honesty and Ethical Behavior: Students are expected to exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in all their academic activities. This includes the avoidance of plagiarism and falsification of data. Students are also expected to treat all members of the class with respect. 
    誠實和道德行為：學生在所有學術活動中都應該展現誠實和道德行為，這包括避免抄襲，篡改資料，並尊重所有課堂中的成員。
     
  2. Understanding Plagiarism and Respect for Intellectual Property: Proper citation of sources is mandatory in all academic work. Using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism. Students must respect and recognize the intellectual work of others; this includes understanding and avoiding plagiarism, as well as practicing proper citation and referencing.
    理解抄襲並尊重智慧財產：所有學術工作中都必須適當引用來源。未經適當註明而使用他人的作品將被視為抄襲。學生必須尊重並認識到他人的智慧創作，這包括理解並避免抄襲，並實踐正確適當的引用和註明參考資料。
     
  3. Adherence to Exam Rules and Personal Accountability: All students must follow exam rules. Using unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating. Moreover, all assignments, tests, and projects should be completed independently unless specified as group work. Sharing answers, copying work, or using unauthorized resources is seen as academic dishonesty.
    遵守考試規則與對個人學習負責：所有學生都必須遵守考試規則。在考試中使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊將被視為作弊。此外，除非明確規定為團隊作業，否則所有的作業、考試和專案都應獨立完成。分享答案、抄襲作業或使用未經授權的資源將被視為學術不誠實。
     
  4. Consequences of Violating Academic Integrity: Any violations of academic integrity, including plagiarism and cheating, will be subject to disciplinary action. Consequences may range from grade reduction to failing the course, depending on the severity of the violation. Other disciplinary actions, as per the instructor's discretion, may also be considered.
    違反學術誠信的後果：任何違反學術誠信的行為，包括抄襲和作弊，將受到紀律處分。根據違規的嚴重程度，懲罰可能從降低成績到不通過課程不等。另外，根據教師的判斷，也可能考慮其他的紀律行動。

policy.tpa_score_new:
課堂規定：
Class Rules:
 
  1. 繳交、上傳作業請務必準時， 一律不接受遲交或補交作業 (請假者請自行注意作業繳交日期)。
    Please ensure to submit or upload your assignments on time. The instructor will not accept any late or makeup assignments, even in cases of absence. If you miss a class, please check and keep track of the assignment deadlines.
     
  2. 點名時一次點兩節課，點名後才進教室者，該節將以曠課論，並請同學於課間自行找教師補點名，以銷掉第二節課之曠課記錄。
    During roll call, attendance is marked for two class periods at once. If you arrive late and miss roll call, you will be marked as absent for both class periods. However, if you arrive during the first class period but after the roll call, please see the instructor during the break to correct your attendance status for the second class period. Otherwise, you will be marked absent for both.
     
  3. 關於請假與曠課：
    • 請假每節扣「課堂表現」總成績0.5分，曠課每節扣「課堂表現」總成績1分。
    • 缺課(包含請假和曠課)次數達12節或以上將無法通過此課程，課程成績以0分計。
    Regarding Excused Absences and Unexcused Absences:
    • Each excused absence will result in a 0.5-point deduction from the overall "Class Performance" grade, while each unexcused absence will result in a 1-point deduction from the same.
    • Missing 12 classes or more (including excused and unexcused absences) will automatically fail the course with a grade of zero.
     
  4. 補考/補做練習一律從80分起扣。
    All scores for makeup quizzes or exercises start from a maximum of 80 points. In other words, the highest score you can achieve for a makeup quiz or exercise is 80, regardless of your performance.
     
  5. 申請課堂小考或練習補考/補做之規定：一學期最多可申請2次，有於系統請假者才可申請，遲到、曠課一律不接受補考或補做。
    Regarding makeup quizzes and exercises: You can take makeup quizzes or exercises up to two times per semester. However, this is conditional upon having an officially recorded leave of absence in the school system. In other words, if you miss a quiz or exercise due to tardiness or unexcused absence from class, you will not be eligible to take the makeup quiz or exercise.
     
  6. 申請補考/補做請於原時間之一個禮拜內申請，逾時不接受補考/補做申請。
    If you wish to take a makeup quiz or exercise, please submit a request to the instructor within one week of the original quiz/exercise date. Any requests made after this period will not be accepted.
     
  7. 期中考和期末考/報告一率不接受補考，除非為特殊原因並符合以下三項：
    • 於考試日期前至少2個禮拜事先告知授課教師
    • 需提供相關正式證明文件 (住院證明、手術證明、參賽證明等)
    • 經授課教師事先同意
    No makeup exams or presentations are allowed for the midterm or final unless there are special circumstances that meet the following three conditions:
    • The instructor has been informed at least two weeks prior to the exam or presentation date;
    • Relevant official documentation can be provided (such as proof of hospitalization, surgery, competition participation, etc.);
    • The instructor has approved the makeup exam or presentation in advance.
     
  8. 期中考/期末考沒有出現或是沒有依規定申請補考的同學，考試成績一律0分。
    If a student does not show up on the day of the midterm exam or final exam, or fails to apply for a makeup exam/presentation according to the rules, the student will automatically receive a score of zero for the exam/presentation.
     
  9. 考試請遵照學校之考場規定，若作弊者一律以0分計算並呈報學生獎懲委員會。
    Please follow the university's exam regulations. Any cheating will result in a score of zero for the exam, and such cases will be referred to the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee.
